Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in data interpretation and logical reasoning. In Step 3, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the film "Dilan 1991" was released in 1991 based on the title containing the year "1991" and a search result snippet mentioning "tahun 1991" (the year 1991). However, the actual search results from the WebSurfer in Step 2 clearly indicated that the film "Dilan 1991" is a **2019** Indonesian film (released Feb 28, 2019). The Planner failed to distinguish between the film's title (which references the year 1991 in the story) and its actual release date. Instead of verifying the release year from the explicit "2019" metadata shown in the search results, the Planner conflated the title's historical reference with the release date, leading to the false conclusion that Dilan 1991 (1991) came out before Celine: Through The Eyes Of The World (2010).
